x-bump-note: 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0 is nested-field-additive: three new OPTIONAL top-level string properties (market_scope, target_uid, target_label), no `required` change. RE-VENDOR: coordinator_core/frontmatter/schemas/research-synthesis.schema.json (claude-klabauter) needs re-vendor from this commit.
description: Run-level deep-research synthesis record; frontmatter index over a PROTECTED expressive prose body.

title.description: Human-readable label for this research synthesis document.

question.description: The research question this synthesis addresses.

created.description: Fleet-canonical temporal key (YYYY-MM-DD); enables --since/--older-than filtering in query-records per D4. Records lacking `created` are excluded by temporal filters.

pipeline.description: Deep-research pipeline variant used to produce this synthesis.

source_count.description: Number of sources consulted during the research run.

topic_facets.description: List of topic facets or sub-themes covered by this synthesis.

coverage_score.description: Coverage score on a 1-5 scale, sourced from the gap-report produced during the research run.

confidence_summary.description: Producer-computed aggregate confidence label for the synthesis. OPTIONAL/derived — prefer `--type research-claim --where confidence=HIGH` for confidence-filtered queries rather than filtering on this field.

market_scope.description: Addressing kind for this dive, so a CorpusRequest can scope to a subject repo, a peer, or a market category. OPTIONAL — a dive with no market_scope set is unaddressable and reports in CorpusResult.dark rather than matching silently.

target_uid.description: Addressing target for market_scope: a competitor_uid for `peer`, a repo shortname for `subject_repo`, or a category_id for `market_category` — one vocabulary, no parallel field.

target_label.description: Human-readable label for the market_scope/target_uid addressing pair.
